description: Same calculations as the fixed-income page. Supply actual dated positive cash flows including redemption, settlement, currency, and either total outlay (clean price + accrued interest + fees) or annual-effective yield as a fraction. Returns price, annual-effective ACT/365F IRR, Macaulay and modified duration, convexity, DV01, maturity and repricing scenarios. Or select one of the 10 published bond ETFs to read N-PORT exposures and reported curve risks; coupon is not yield. No quota consumed, nothing stored, no advice. Search/fetch clients: bond: settlement=2026-11-04; currency=EUR; price=100; 2027-11-04=105. ETF example: bond: etf=TLT; country=US; haircut=0.1

country.description: With etf: two-letter ISO code of the government whose bonds are shocked in the sovereign scenario (required with haircut, spread_duration or spread_bps).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the price and of every cash flow, e.g. EUR. Required with flows.

etf.description: Instead of flows: one of the 10 published bond ETFs, to read its N-PORT exposures and reported curve risks. Accepts only country, haircut, spread_duration, spread_bps and source as other arguments.

flows.description: Every future payment received after settlement, coupons and redemption, as {"date":"YYYY-MM-DD","amount":number ≥ 0}; up to 1,000. Example: [{"date":"2027-11-04","amount":105}].

fx_change.description: With flows: exchange-rate change applied in the scenario, as a fraction greater than −1 (0.05 = +5%, −0.1 = −10%).

haircut.description: With etf and country: loss on that government's bonds as a fraction of their value, 0 to 1 (0.1 = 10%).

price.description: Total outlay in the same unit as the flows: clean price + accrued interest + fees (e.g. 101.2 for flows per 100 of nominal). Give price or yield, not both.

rate_bps.description: With flows: parallel change of interest rates in basis points for the repricing scenario (100 = +1 percentage point).

settlement.description: Settlement (purchase) date, YYYY-MM-DD. Required with flows.

source.description: Where the user took the cash flows or the price (prospectus, broker page); repeated in the result and not verified by MFM.

spread_bps.description: Spread change in basis points (100 = 1 percentage point): with flows for the repricing scenario; with etf and country together with spread_duration.

spread_duration.description: With etf and country, together with spread_bps: spread duration in years used for the spread scenario.

yield.description: Annual-effective yield as a fraction (0.035 = 3.5%), used to compute the price. Give price or yield, not both.
